Title: AI Engineer
Location: San Pedro Garza García, Nuevo León, Mexico
Description: Johnson Controls International (JCI) is seeking an AI Engineer to join our innovative and impact-driven Data Science and Analytics team. This role is ideal for an engineer who combines solid software, data, and ML engineering skills with hands-on Generative AI experience—and a data scientist's curiosity for how models behave. You build the pipelines, tooling, and applications that turn AI and LLM models into dependable production software. As an AI Engineer, you will independently own the end-to-end delivery of defined AI projects—from data pipeline through deployed application. You will make sound technical decisions within your scope, partner directly with cross-functional stakeholders, and guide junior engineers on specific problems as you deliver measurable business value. How You Will Do It Generative AI Systems & Applications Develop and deploy Generative AI systems and LLM-powered applications (e.g., GPT, Claude, LLaMA) for use cases such as enterprise search, document summarization, and conversational AI. Apply prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and orchestration techniques to adapt foundation models for domain-specific applications. Build agentic workflows and task-specific AI agents—using Palantir AIP or the Microsoft Agent Framework—that orchestrate tools, retrieval, and reasoning. Evaluate and improve model outputs for accuracy, relevance, latency, and cost, applying data science techniques to measure and validate performance. Data, ML & Software Engineering Build and maintain the data pipelines that feed AI systems—ingestion, transformation, and ETL across structured and unstructured sources (e.g., Snowflake, Azure). Develop and operate ML pipelines and MLOps workflows—training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring—using CI/CD, containerization (Docker), and model serving. Build reusable components, services, and APIs around AI models that help the team ship features faster. Implement retrieval and embedding workflows (RAG, vector databases) for scalable, accurate knowledge retrieval. Apply software engineering best practices—testing, version control, and code review—across your projects. Business Impact & Stakeholder Communication Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to translate business challenges into AI solutions. Support workshops and proofs-of-concept that demonstrate the value of LLM and agent use cases across business units. Translate model outputs, data findings, and technical tradeoffs into clear insights for non-technical audiences. Mentorship & Collaboration Guide junior engineers on specific technical problems and code quality. Contribute to design discussions and technical decisions within the team. Share knowledge and help raise the bar on engineering and data science practices. Qualifications & Experience Education in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical or quantitative discipline. 2–5 years of experience in software, data, ML engineering, or data science, including hands-on work with LLMs or generative AI. Demonstrated success delivering data or ML pipelines and AI/ML solutions to production. Experience with data science fundamentals—exploratory analysis, statistical modeling, or classic ML (classification, regression, forecasting). Experience with cloud AI platforms such as Azure OpenAI/Azure ML, AWS SageMaker/Bedrock, or Google Cloud Vertex AI. Technical Expertise Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, with good software engineering habits—testing, version control, and clean code. Hands-on experience with the Generative AI stack: prompt engineering, fine-tuning (e.g., LoRA), LLM orchestration, and agent frameworks (LangChain, Semantic Kernel, Microsoft Agent Framework). Experience building ETL and ML pipelines and applying MLOps practices (CI/CD, Docker, model serving). Familiarity with data science libraries and workflows—pandas, scikit-learn, and model evaluation and experimentation. Experience with JCI's stack—or comparable platforms—including Palantir AIP, Azure ML, Microsoft Agent Framework, Power Automate, and Snowflake. Working knowledge of embeddings, vector databases, and retrieval systems. Soft Skills Ability to own projects and communicate progress, risks, and tradeoffs clearly. Strong collaboration skills across product, engineering, and business teams. Comfortable presenting technical and analytical work to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Self-directed problem solver who manages priorities independently. Preferred Qualifications Experience with IoT, edge analytics, or smart building systems. Familiarity with LLMOps, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or similar orchestration frameworks. Data science depth—statistical modeling, experimentation, or deep learning (forecasting, computer vision, or NLP). Experience with the Microsoft ecosystem (Microsoft 365 Copilot, SharePoint, Power Platform, Snowflake). Knowledge of data privacy and governance considerations for enterprise LLM usage. Johnson Controls does not request pregnancy or HIV testing as a condition for hiring, continued employment, or promotion , in accordance with its commitment to labor equality and non-discrimination.

Title: Junior AI/ML Engineer
Description: We are hiring Junior AI/ML Engineers to help build AI agents that handle customer conversations through voice and chat. You'll work on the retrieval, orchestration, APIs, and integrations behind these systems, helping turn working prototypes into reliable production solutions. You'll collaborate with full-stack engineers, CX designers, and operations teams to develop AI-powered experiences that are practical, secure, and effective. We welcome candidates with relevant professional experience, internships, research, or hands-on projects who are eager to develop their skills and contribute to real-world AI applications. What You'll Do Build AI agents: Develop conversational agents that interact with users, call tools and APIs, and hand conversations off to human agents when needed. Develop retrieval pipelines: Build retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines that help AI agents answer questions using approved information sources. Integrate systems: Connect AI agents with CRMs, ticketing systems, databases, and messaging channels. Build and manage APIs: Work with API gateways, authentication, rate limits, and versioning. Support voice AI development: Help build voice agents using speech-to-text, large language models (LLMs), and text-to-speech in English and Spanish. Test and improve quality: Use evaluations, automated tests, and guardrails to improve accuracy, reliability, and safety. Support deployment and monitoring: Ship and maintain solutions through CI/CD, monitoring, and documentation. Collaborate across teams: Work with engineering, CX design, and operations colleagues to turn prototypes into production-ready solutions. Our Technology Stack Our primary cloud platform is Microsoft Azure, but experience with AWS or Google Cloud is also valuable. Relevant technologies include Python, Git, Docker, SQL, LLM APIs, agent frameworks, RAG pipelines, REST APIs, API gateways, webhooks, messaging systems, and cloud-based AI services. Experience with any one of the named tools in each relevant area is sufficient. You don't need to have used every framework or platform listed. Working Environment This is a fully remote opportunity for candidates based in Colombia or Mexico. You'll work with full-stack engineers, CX designers, and operations teams to build and improve AI-powered customer conversation solutions. We value curiosity, practical problem-solving, collaboration, and a willingness to learn. You'll have the opportunity to contribute to AI agents, retrieval systems, integrations, and voice AI applications while developing your engineering skills. ﻿ ﻿Hiring Process To ensure fairness and consistency, all applicants must complete every stage of the hiring process. Our process includes: Resume Review Pre-Screen Questionnaire One-Way Video Interview Live Interview Please Note ﻿This is an English-speaking role that requires strong written and verbal English communication skills. All resumes must be submitted in English to be considered for this position. Requirements: What You'll Bring 1–3 years of experience in software engineering or ML engineering. Relevant internships and research experience count. Solid Python skills and familiarity with Git, Docker, and basic SQL. Experience with at least one cloud platform: Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud. Hands-on experience with an LLM API, such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or Azure OpenAI. Experience building an AI agent that calls tools or APIs, using a framework such as LangChain, LangGraph, or Semantic Kernel. Experience building a RAG pipeline, including document chunking, embeddings, vector search, and retrieval tuning. Experience building and consuming REST APIs, including authentication, rate limits, and versioning, with some exposure to API gateways. Experience connecting systems through webhooks, SDKs, or message queues, such as integrating an application with a CRM or database. Understanding of ML fundamentals, including embeddings, train/test splits, and evaluation metrics such as precision and recall. Professional written and spoken English and Spanish. Based in Colombia or Mexico. Candidates with strong foundational knowledge and relevant academic, internship, research, or personal project experience are encouraged to apply. Nice to Have Experience with speech AI or voice agent technologies, such as Azure AI Speech, Whisper, LiveKit, or Pipecat. Familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or integration platforms such as Azure Logic Apps or n8n. Experience with CRM and contact center APIs, including Dynamics 365, Salesforce, or Zendesk. Familiarity with LLM evaluation tools such as Langfuse or Ragas. Cloud AI certifications or other relevant technical certifications.

Rediseño de procesos y documentación del estado actual y estado deseado. Gestión de proyectos y/o gestión de producto. Gestión del cambio y adopción de nuevas soluciones. Idioma Inglés avanzado. Construir y analizar las métricas de pólizas individuales considerando el inventario, primas promedios y descuentos para la presentación de información a la Dirección de Suscripción de Autos. Title: Supply Planner II (SAP S/4HANA & Planning Experience)
Description: Job Description As a Supply Planner II here at Honeywell, you will manage supply planning to ensure timely delivery of materials and products. Collaborate with procurement, production, and logistics to optimize inventory and enhance supply chain efficiency. You will report directly to our Materials Management Director, and you’ll work out of our MTY location on a hybrid work schedule. As a S4 Supply Chain Planning Analyst here at Honeywell Technologies, you will play a vital role in leveraging data analytics to enhance S4 planning processes. You will analyze supply chain data to provide actionable insights that improve planning accuracy, optimize inventory levels, and support decision-making across the supply chain network. In this role, your work will provide insights to improve supply chain efficiency, reduce costs, and increase customer satisfaction by ensuring the right products are available at the right time through data-driven supply planning strategies. Responsibilities Develop and maintain SAP S/4HANA reporting solutions supporting supply planning, inventory management, material availability, and planning execution. Design, build, and enhance S/4 reporting dashboards, KPI scorecards, and analytical reports used by planning, operations, and leadership teams. Develop S4 based reporting to support supply planning and execution. Develop and maintain analytics dashboards and reports to support supply planning decision-making. Analyze supply planning data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement. Collaborate with cross-functional teams including procurement, production, and logistics to align supply planning analytics with business objectives. Utilize advanced analytics tools and techniques to optimize supply planning processes. Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying automation opportunities and process enhancements. Support roadmap for AI initiatives and implementation. Identify and mitigate risks associated with data quality issues that could lead to MRP failures or supply chain disruptions. Provide ongoing support and training to stakeholders on analytics practices and tools. Monitor and report on data quality metrics, implementing corrective actions as necessary. Qualifications YOU MUST HAVE 4+ years of experience in supply chain analytics or supply planning analytics. 2+ years of experience transforming SAP S/4HANA planning data into actionable business insights through SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), SAP Fiori Reporting, Embedded Analytics, CDS Views, and advanced visualization tools. Experience with data visualization tools like Power BI. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights. Proven experience in supply chain processes. Strong understanding of MRP systems and data management principles. Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, capable of influencing stakeholders at all levels. Knowledge of supply planning processes and inventory management principles. WE VALUE Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field. Supply Chain Certifications such as CSCP / CPIM / CPSM / Lean Six Sigma. Proficiency in data analytics tools and programming languages such as Python, R, and SQL. Familiarity with advanced analytics techniques including predictive modeling and machine learning. About Us Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

Title: Commercial Planning & Data Lead
Description: Sobre Birdman En Birdman estamos construyendo una de las empresas de nutrición y bienestar plant-based de mayor crecimiento en México. Operamos en un entorno dinámico, multicanal y en constante evolución, donde tomar mejores decisiones a partir de datos es fundamental para seguir creciendo de manera rentable y sostenible. Como parte de nuestro equipo de Revenue Growth Management , buscamos a una persona que quiera transformar datos, demanda e inventarios en decisiones comerciales de alto impacto. Sobre la posición Buscamos un/a Commercial Planning & Data Lead que se convierta en dueño/a del número único de demanda de Birdman , conectando forecast, inventarios, datos y visión financiera para apoyar la toma de decisiones del negocio. Tu reto será asegurar que tengamos el inventario correcto, en el lugar correcto y en el momento correcto, minimizando quiebres, sobreinventario y riesgo de caducidad, mientras entiendes y cuantificas el impacto de cada decisión en revenue, margen y capital de trabajo . Trabajarás de manera transversal con Revenue, Supply Chain, Producción, Finanzas, Data & BI y nuestros diferentes canales comerciales en México y Estados Unidos. Este no es únicamente un rol de planeación: buscamos a alguien capaz de construir modelos, automatizar procesos, cuestionar supuestos y convertir análisis complejos en decisiones accionables para el negocio . ¿Qué harás? Ser dueño/a del ciclo mensual de forecast de demanda end-to-end , consolidando un único número para la compañía. Analizar demanda, tendencias, estacionalidades, promociones y desviaciones para mejorar continuamente la precisión del forecast. Administrar la asignación comercial de inventarios entre canales y almacenes. Monitorear niveles de inventario, días de inventario, OOS, fill rate, OTIF y riesgo de caducidad. Cuantificar en dinero el revenue at risk por OOS y el costo asociado al sobreinventario. Construir business cases para decisiones de inventario, considerando su impacto en margen, cash y capital de trabajo. Evaluar escenarios como rebalanceos entre almacenes, compras extraordinarias, liquidaciones, donaciones o destrucción de inventario. Liderar la sección de forecast e inventarios dentro del MBR, transformando métricas en interpretación, acciones y resultados. Trabajar de manera cercana con Supply y Producción dentro de la cadencia de S&OP. Entregar insumos de cierre con visión P&L en coordinación con Finanzas. Construir y automatizar reportes, alertas y procesos que permitan tomar decisiones más rápidas. Utilizar SQL, Excel/Power Query, herramientas de BI, IA y scripting para explotar información y reducir procesos manuales. Documentar procesos, decisiones, supuestos y runbooks para construir una operación escalable y auditable. El rol es dueño del input de demanda y de la asignación comercial del inventario ; no será responsable de planear producción ni de liderar S&OP end-to-end. Requirements ¿Qué buscamos? 3 a 6 años de experiencia en Demand Planning, FP&A, Commercial Finance, Revenue Management, Business Operations, consultoría estratégica o posiciones similares. Experiencia siendo dueño/a de un ciclo recurrente de forecast o proyección financiera de principio a fin . Experiencia en empresas de consumo masivo (CPG), retail, Food & Beverage, suplementos/nutrición o industrias similares. Experiencia administrando inventarios o demanda en múltiples canales. Capacidad para conectar decisiones operativas con su impacto financiero. Experiencia construyendo modelos, business cases y análisis de escenarios. Experiencia trabajando con múltiples stakeholders y áreas funcionales. Historial de construcción o automatización de reportes/procesos que posteriormente hayan sido utilizados por otras personas. Deseable experiencia en operaciones multicanal, eCommerce o multi-país. Conocimientos técnicos Buscamos un perfil altamente analítico y hands-on: Excel avanzado + Power Query + modelado financiero SQL Power BI u otra herramienta de Business Intelligence Uso productivo de IA generativa y scripting para automatización Conocimiento de forecasting: series de tiempo, baseline + uplift, WMAPE/MAPE, bias y análisis de causa raíz. Conocimientos sólidos de S&OP y administración de inventarios: DOI, stock de seguridad, asignación, OTIF y fill rate. Capacidad para leer un P&L y explicar cómo una decisión operativa impacta margen y capital de trabajo. Python para automatización de reportes y alertas Experiencia con herramientas de Demand Planning como Netstock, Slimstock o SAP IBP Formación Carrera terminada en áreas como: Ingeniería Industrial Actuaría Economía Matemáticas Aplicadas Administración Finanzas Contaduría O carreras afines MBA o maestría en Finanzas/Economía será considerada una señal positiva. Idioma Inglés profesional avanzado (C1+) indispensable. La posición tiene exposición a la operación de Estados Unidos. ¿Qué te hará destacar? Buscamos a alguien con una combinación poco común: capacidad analítica + visión financiera + ejecución + ownership . Una persona que no espere a que alguien le diga qué analizar; que detecte anomalías, cuestione el dato, llegue a la causa raíz y construya una solución que evite que el mismo problema vuelva a ocurrir. Alguien cómodo/a trabajando como contribuidor individual , tomando decisiones con autonomía y construyendo procesos mientras los ejecuta. Nuestros principios especialmente importantes para esta posición son Ownership & Proactiveness y Big Thinking & Highest Standards . Modalidad y ubicación 📍 Corporativo Birdman — Guadalajara, Jalisco 🏢 Modalidad 100% presencial ¿Listo/a para despegar? Si disfrutas transformar datos en decisiones, construir modelos desde cero y entender no solo cuánto inventario tenemos , sino cuánto dinero está en juego y qué deberíamos hacer al respecto , queremos conocerte. ¡Únete a Birdman y emprende el vuelo con nosotros! 🚀

Title: Junior AI/ML Engineer
Description: We are hiring Junior AI/ML Engineers to help build AI agents that handle customer conversations through voice and chat. You'll work on the retrieval, orchestration, APIs, and integrations behind these systems, helping turn working prototypes into reliable production solutions. You'll collaborate with full-stack engineers, CX designers, and operations teams to develop AI-powered experiences that are practical, secure, and effective. We welcome candidates with relevant professional experience, internships, research, or hands-on projects who are eager to develop their skills and contribute to real-world AI applications. What You'll Do Build AI agents: Develop conversational agents that interact with users, call tools and APIs, and hand conversations off to human agents when needed. Develop retrieval pipelines: Build retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines that help AI agents answer questions using approved information sources. Integrate systems: Connect AI agents with CRMs, ticketing systems, databases, and messaging channels. Build and manage APIs: Work with API gateways, authentication, rate limits, and versioning. Support voice AI development: Help build voice agents using speech-to-text, large language models (LLMs), and text-to-speech in English and Spanish. Test and improve quality: Use evaluations, automated tests, and guardrails to improve accuracy, reliability, and safety. Support deployment and monitoring: Ship and maintain solutions through CI/CD, monitoring, and documentation. Collaborate across teams: Work with engineering, CX design, and operations colleagues to turn prototypes into production-ready solutions. Our Technology Stack Our primary cloud platform is Microsoft Azure, but experience with AWS or Google Cloud is also valuable. Relevant technologies include Python, Git, Docker, SQL, LLM APIs, agent frameworks, RAG pipelines, REST APIs, API gateways, webhooks, messaging systems, and cloud-based AI services. Experience with any one of the named tools in each relevant area is sufficient. You don't need to have used every framework or platform listed. Working Environment This is a fully remote opportunity for candidates based in Colombia or Mexico. You'll work with full-stack engineers, CX designers, and operations teams to build and improve AI-powered customer conversation solutions. We value curiosity, practical problem-solving, collaboration, and a willingness to learn. You'll have the opportunity to contribute to AI agents, retrieval systems, integrations, and voice AI applications while developing your engineering skills. ﻿ ﻿Hiring Process To ensure fairness and consistency, all applicants must complete every stage of the hiring process. Our process includes: Resume Review Pre-Screen Questionnaire One-Way Video Interview Live Interview Please Note ﻿This is an English-speaking role that requires strong written and verbal English communication skills. All resumes must be submitted in English to be considered for this position. Requirements: What You'll Bring 1–3 years of experience in software engineering or ML engineering. Relevant internships and research experience count. Solid Python skills and familiarity with Git, Docker, and basic SQL. Experience with at least one cloud platform: Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud. Hands-on experience with an LLM API, such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or Azure OpenAI. Experience building an AI agent that calls tools or APIs, using a framework such as LangChain, LangGraph, or Semantic Kernel. Experience building a RAG pipeline, including document chunking, embeddings, vector search, and retrieval tuning. Experience building and consuming REST APIs, including authentication, rate limits, and versioning, with some exposure to API gateways. Experience connecting systems through webhooks, SDKs, or message queues, such as integrating an application with a CRM or database. Understanding of ML fundamentals, including embeddings, train/test splits, and evaluation metrics such as precision and recall. Professional written and spoken English and Spanish. Based in Colombia or Mexico. Candidates with strong foundational knowledge and relevant academic, internship, research, or personal project experience are encouraged to apply. Nice to Have Experience with speech AI or voice agent technologies, such as Azure AI Speech, Whisper, LiveKit, or Pipecat. Familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or integration platforms such as Azure Logic Apps or n8n. Experience with CRM and contact center APIs, including Dynamics 365, Salesforce, or Zendesk. Familiarity with LLM evaluation tools such as Langfuse or Ragas. Cloud AI certifications or other relevant technical certifications.

Description: Our Company At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information.  Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes.  With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters.  Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach.  Teradata delivers real business value with AI. Our Internship Program Our Mexico Intern program starts in September ending in March.  We offer a fast-paced, flexible, fun environment where you will have the opportunity to work on meaningful projects and face new challenges.  Our culture isn’t just about one kind of person.  So many individuals make up who we are, making us that much more unique.  This is what sets apart the dynamic, diverse, and collaborative environment that is Teradata. What You’ll Do You will contribute across the analytics delivery lifecycle—from understanding data and building solutions, to exploring AI capabilities that help our team work smarter. Explore and analyze data using SQL and Python, asking business questions, spotting patterns, and turning raw datasets into clear, actionable insights for internal stakeholders. Build and test analytics prototypes—dashboards, reports, or data models—that give teams faster access to the information they need to make decisions. Experiment with AI and agentic tools on top of Teradata’s platform, helping automate repetitive analyst tasks and surface insights that would otherwise take days to find manually. Validate data quality across pipelines—checking for completeness, accuracy, and consistency—and flag issues with clear documentation so engineers can act quickly. Act as a Customer Zero advocate: use Teradata’s own autonomous knowledge platform capabilities day-to-day, compare them honestly against best-in-class tools in the market, and share structured feedback that helps shape what we build next. What You'll Gain Real project experience on a live analytics platform used by a global enterprise—not a training sandbox—so you graduate with work you can talk about in any interview. A practical understanding of how AI is being applied inside a data company right now: what works, what doesn’t, and how teams make decisions about which tools to adopt. Mentorship from senior engineers and data scientists through weekly 1:1s, regular code reviews, and a structured mid-program check-in to keep your growth on track. A Customer Zero experience: you will have used, evaluated, and influenced Teradata’s own AI platform—giving you a rare perspective on enterprise product development that most early-career candidates simply don’t have. Who You’ll Work With You will sit on the Analytics Center of Excellence (CoE) within Teradata’s Enterprise Knowledge Platform & Intelligence Engineering organization, a cross-functional team of solutions analysts, data scientists, data engineers, data modelers, architects, and product managers who translate business needs into scalable analytics solutions.  This role reports to the Director of Analytics CoE.  Day-to-day, you will collaborate closely with data engineers on pipeline design, with AI/ML engineers on agent development, and with DevOps engineers on CI/CD automation—giving you broad exposure to the full analytics delivery lifecycle. What Makes You a Qualified Candidate Currently pursuing a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field Working knowledge of SQL and Python for data analysis Comfortable with Git and basic command-line tools Strong communication skills in English; able to explain findings to a non-technical audience Available for a 12–16 week hybrid internship Preferred Curiosity about AI, large language models, or data engineering—whether through coursework, projects, or self-study Exposure to a cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) or a data visualization tool (Tableau, Power BI) Any experience experimenting with LLM APIs or agentic frameworks (LangChain, AutoGen, or similar) What You’ll Bring You are genuinely curious about data and AI—you have explored tools, asked questions, or built something small just to understand how it works. You learn by doing and are not afraid to be wrong; you ask for feedback early and iterate quickly rather than waiting for the perfect answer. You communicate clearly and honestly—when something is confusing or unclear, you say so and ask questions rather than guessing. You care about the quality of your work and the people who will use it, whether that’s a teammate reading your code or a stakeholder relying on your analysis. Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are an anti-racist company because our dedication to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is more than a statement. It is a deep commitment to doing the work to foster an equitable environment that celebrates people for all of who they are. Teradata invites all identities and backgrounds in the workplace. We work with deliberation and intent to ensure we are cultivating collaboration and inclusivity across our global organization. ​ We are proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, ancestry, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related conditions), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, gender identity or expression, military and veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

Title: Senior Manager, Insights & Analytics, GOC

Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working. For more information, visit wppmedia.com. Role Summary And Impact As part of the Global Operations Centre (GOC), you will work closely with teams across the United States, Europe, and Asia to deliver high-impact solutions in a collaborative, multicultural environment. We are looking for a Senior Manager who will: Report directly to the VP of Investment & Partnerships, connecting media investment strategy with business intelligence and owning the end-to-end data workflow for partner spend forecasting, tracking, and performance validation. Extract, analyze, and validate spend forecasts from CoreM, WPP Media’s proprietary client spend forecasting dashboard. Gather and consolidate forecasts across Agency Client Teams, MM&D Solutions, and MM&D Activation, covering programmatic, social, advanced TV, linear TV, radio, out-of-home, and print. Build and maintain unified reporting models that combine CoreM forecasts with agency, Solutions, and Activation data across deal and non-deal partners. Produce recurring deal-partner spend pacing reports, identifying trends, risks, and potential shortfalls that could affect trading commitments. Extract spend pacing data from MediaOcean and reconcile it with vendor delivery data to monitor partner performance. Investigate and resolve discrepancies between forecasted spend and actual delivery, collaborating with vendors and agency teams to ensure accurate reporting. Use Canadian market intelligence sources, including nLogic Lens, Comscore, CRTC, and Guideline, to validate investment decisions and contextualize performance. Develop data-backed presentations and supporting materials for publisher negotiations and strategic partnership reviews. Identify opportunities to automate data collection and reporting, improving operational efficiency, consistency, and data quality. Collaborate closely with agency teams, Solutions and Activation specialists, and external media partners to communicate findings and support investment decisions. Skills And Experience Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Business Analytics, Project Management, or a related field. 3–5 years of professional experience in media planning, media buying, investment, or analytics. Deep understanding of the Canadian media landscape, including regulators, publishers, and vendor ecosystems. Experience with media investment and measurement tools such as MediaOcean/Prisma, nLogic Lens and FT, Comscore, and Airware. Advanced Excel proficiency, including nested formulas, pivot tables, Power Query, and data modeling. Experience using Tableau and/or Power BI to develop dashboards and communicate findings. Basic knowledge of SQL is a plus. Proficiency in PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex datasets and translate findings into actionable recommendations. Excellent attention to detail and data quality assurance skills, particularly when validating forecasts, reconciling delivery data, and investigating discrepancies. Strong project and time management skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple reporting requirements and meet deadlines. Effective communication and relationship-building skills for collaborating with agency teams, internal stakeholders, and external media partners. A proactive approach to identifying anomalies, investigating their causes, and improving reporting processes. Life At WPP Media & Benefits Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary , investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically , firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. Title: Junior AI/ML Engineer
Description: We are hiring Junior AI/ML Engineers to help build AI agents that handle customer conversations through voice and chat. You'll work on the retrieval, orchestration, APIs, and integrations behind these systems, helping turn working prototypes into reliable production solutions. You'll collaborate with full-stack engineers, CX designers, and operations teams to develop AI-powered experiences that are practical, secure, and effective. We welcome candidates with relevant professional experience, internships, research, or hands-on projects who are eager to develop their skills and contribute to real-world AI applications. What You'll Do Build AI agents: Develop conversational agents that interact with users, call tools and APIs, and hand conversations off to human agents when needed. Develop retrieval pipelines: Build retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines that help AI agents answer questions using approved information sources. Integrate systems: Connect AI agents with CRMs, ticketing systems, databases, and messaging channels. Build and manage APIs: Work with API gateways, authentication, rate limits, and versioning. Support voice AI development: Help build voice agents using speech-to-text, large language models (LLMs), and text-to-speech in English and Spanish. Test and improve quality: Use evaluations, automated tests, and guardrails to improve accuracy, reliability, and safety. Support deployment and monitoring: Ship and maintain solutions through CI/CD, monitoring, and documentation. Collaborate across teams: Work with engineering, CX design, and operations colleagues to turn prototypes into production-ready solutions. Our Technology Stack Our primary cloud platform is Microsoft Azure, but experience with AWS or Google Cloud is also valuable. Relevant technologies include Python, Git, Docker, SQL, LLM APIs, agent frameworks, RAG pipelines, REST APIs, API gateways, webhooks, messaging systems, and cloud-based AI services. Experience with any one of the named tools in each relevant area is sufficient. You don't need to have used every framework or platform listed. Working Environment This is a fully remote opportunity for candidates based in Colombia or Mexico. You'll work with full-stack engineers, CX designers, and operations teams to build and improve AI-powered customer conversation solutions. We value curiosity, practical problem-solving, collaboration, and a willingness to learn. You'll have the opportunity to contribute to AI agents, retrieval systems, integrations, and voice AI applications while developing your engineering skills. ﻿ ﻿Hiring Process To ensure fairness and consistency, all applicants must complete every stage of the hiring process. Our process includes: Resume Review Pre-Screen Questionnaire One-Way Video Interview Live Interview Please Note ﻿This is an English-speaking role that requires strong written and verbal English communication skills. All resumes must be submitted in English to be considered for this position. Requirements: What You'll Bring 1–3 years of experience in software engineering or ML engineering. Relevant internships and research experience count. Solid Python skills and familiarity with Git, Docker, and basic SQL. Experience with at least one cloud platform: Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud. Hands-on experience with an LLM API, such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or Azure OpenAI. Experience building an AI agent that calls tools or APIs, using a framework such as LangChain, LangGraph, or Semantic Kernel. Experience building a RAG pipeline, including document chunking, embeddings, vector search, and retrieval tuning. Experience building and consuming REST APIs, including authentication, rate limits, and versioning, with some exposure to API gateways. Experience connecting systems through webhooks, SDKs, or message queues, such as integrating an application with a CRM or database. Understanding of ML fundamentals, including embeddings, train/test splits, and evaluation metrics such as precision and recall. Professional written and spoken English and Spanish. Based in Colombia or Mexico. Candidates with strong foundational knowledge and relevant academic, internship, research, or personal project experience are encouraged to apply. Nice to Have Experience with speech AI or voice agent technologies, such as Azure AI Speech, Whisper, LiveKit, or Pipecat. Familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or integration platforms such as Azure Logic Apps or n8n. Experience with CRM and contact center APIs, including Dynamics 365, Salesforce, or Zendesk. Familiarity with LLM evaluation tools such as Langfuse or Ragas. Cloud AI certifications or other relevant technical certifications.

Our vision is bold: to empower healthcare professionals with scalable, trustworthy intelligence and pursue nothing less than the first Nobel Prize in Medicine for Latin America since 1984—with an AI Doctor. Participate in training, onboarding, and support for early adopters. Communicate key clinical insights to product, engineering, and commercial teams. Interest or experience in AI, data science, medical informatics, or digital health strongly preferred. Title: Technical IT Data Project Manager
Description: We are looking for a highly analytical and execution-driven Program Manager who combines strong program delivery expertise with hands-on business analysis, data reporting, and operational analytics capabilities. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex business problems through data, translating ambiguous requirements into actionable plans, and driving enterprise initiatives from concept to execution. As a key partner across technical and business teams, you will leverage data from multiple enterprise systems to generate insights, increase operational visibility, improve processes, and support strategic decision-making. You will be responsible for building reporting frameworks, developing dashboards and analytics solutions, and ensuring that critical initiatives continue moving forward in a fast-paced and evolving environment. Success in this role requires a unique blend of project management, stakeholder engagement, SQL and analytics expertise, and the ability to operate effectively when requirements, systems, or data structures are not fully defined. What you will work on Partner with business and technical stakeholders to understand operational challenges, gather requirements, and translate them into clear execution plans, documentation, analytics solutions, and measurable outcomes. Write and optimize complex SQL queries in BigQuery to extract, transform, combine, and analyze structured and semi-structured data from multiple enterprise platforms. Design, develop, and maintain scalable dashboards, reports, and data visualizations using Looker Studio, BigQuery, and Google Sheets. Deliver operational analytics and reporting for key business processes, including employee adoption and activation metrics, ServiceNow approval workflows, support operations, and other enterprise programs. Consolidate and synthesize data from diverse enterprise systems to answer business-critical questions, identify trends, uncover inefficiencies, and support decision-making. Build reporting frameworks that provide stakeholders with visibility into project performance, operational metrics, risks, and progress against objectives. Support and help drive enterprise-wide initiatives such as Google Workspace deployments, process improvement programs, service support enhancements, policy updates, and operational transformation efforts. Work through ambiguity by identifying data sources, clarifying requirements, and establishing practical solutions even when systems, schemas, or business processes are not fully documented. Drive project execution by proactively coordinating stakeholders, following up on action items, mitigating risks, and ensuring initiatives maintain momentum through completion. Contribute to the continuous improvement of business processes, reporting practices, and operational effectiveness across the organization. What you will bring 6+ years of experience in Program Management, Business Analysis, Operations, or a related function supporting enterprise-scale initiatives. 6+ years of experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), particularly BigQuery, including complex SQL development, data extraction, transformation, validation, and analysis. Experience creating and maintaining dashboards and data visualizations using Looker Studio or comparable BI platforms. Advanced proficiency in Google Sheets for reporting, data manipulation, and operational analysis. Experience integrating and analyzing data from enterprise platforms such as ServiceNow and other operational systems through APIs, exports, or cloud-based data pipelines. Ability to transform ambiguous business problems into scalable reporting solutions and actionable recommendations. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience creating executive-ready reports, technical documentation, and stakeholder presentations. Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams and proactively drive work forward without direct authority. Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical audiences. Self-starter mentality with the ability to manage multiple priorities, adapt to changing business needs, and thrive in fast-paced environments. Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a passion for using data to improve business outcomes. What you can expect An inspirational place for you to do your best work, be engaged in meaningful ways, and continually develop the skills, competencies and qualities that set our team apart. Compensation commensurate with your qualifications, experience, and other factors including geographic location, market and operational factors. Total Rewards include: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Disability Insurance, 401(k) Savings Plan, Employee Stock Purchase Plan, Professional Development Program, Paid Time Off and Paid Sick Time (in geographies where legally required). Title: Senior Data Engineer
Description: SOBRE EL PUESTO Y EL EQUIPO En TelevisaUnivision, somos la empresa líder mundial de medios de comunicación en español, llegando a millones de consumidores a través de plataformas digitales, streaming, redes sociales, audio, televisión lineal y eventos en vivo. A medida que continuamos expandiendo nuestra plataforma global de streaming, ViX, estamos realizando importantes inversiones en tecnología, datos e innovación para ofrecer experiencias excepcionales a nuestros suscriptores e impulsar el crecimiento sostenible del negocio a largo plazo. El equipo de Ingeniería de Datos (Data Engineering) diseña, desarrolla y opera pipelines de datos de gran volumen y alta velocidad que impulsan ViX. Estos incluyen eventos de reproducción e interacción de usuarios, datos de suscripciones, información publicitaria y el almacén de datos analíticos (data warehouse), que permite transformar esta información en decisiones de negocio. El equipo colabora estrechamente con las áreas de Ingeniería, Producto, Ciencia de Datos y Analítica de TelevisaUnivision. El Senior Data Engineer desempeñará un papel clave en el diseño, desarrollo e implementación de nuestra plataforma de datos para streaming. Será responsable de gestionar integralmente pipelines de datos en producción, desde la ingesta en tiempo real hasta la transformación de datos estructurados y preparados para su análisis. Asimismo, colaborará con los equipos de Ciencia de Datos, Analítica y Producto para comprender sus necesidades de información y llevar las iniciativas hasta su implementación. El candidato ideal combina sólidos conocimientos técnicos con una mentalidad colaborativa, pasión por resolver desafíos complejos relacionados con los datos y compromiso con la entrega de soluciones de alta calidad a gran escala. SOBRE TI Eres un profesional de Ingeniería de Datos que se desenvuelve con éxito en entornos dinámicos y colaborativos, y disfruta transformando datos complejos en información de valor para el negocio. Cuentas Con Amplia experiencia en plataformas modernas de datos en la nube, especialmente Google Cloud Platform (GCP), incluyendo BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Dataflow y Cloud Composer. Dominio avanzado de Python, SQL y frameworks de transformación de datos como dbt. Experiencia práctica en el desarrollo de pipelines de datos a gran escala, tanto por lotes (batch) como en tiempo real (streaming). Experiencia trabajando con sistemas distribuidos a gran escala y tecnologías de Big Data, incluyendo Spark y Hadoop. Experiencia con herramientas de Infraestructura como Código (IaC), como Pulumi o Terraform. Excelentes habilidades de resolución de problemas y capacidad para diseñar soluciones escalables y eficientes. Gran atención al detalle y capacidad para gestionar múltiples prioridades de manera efectiva. Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y colaboración, con capacidad para trabajar con equipos técnicos y no técnicos. Mentalidad de mejora continua y pasión por la mentoría y el intercambio de conocimientos. RESPONSABILIDADES DEL DÍA A DÍA Desarrollo de la plataforma de datos Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener pipelines de datos por lotes (batch) escalables, confiables y eficientes utilizando Airflow (Cloud Composer), Python, SQL y dbt. Desarrollar y mantener pipelines de ingesta de datos en tiempo real que permitan transferir datos de eventos desde Pub/Sub hacia Cloud Storage y BigQuery mediante Dataflow. Desarrollar y optimizar modelos dimensionales de datos y flujos de trabajo dentro del almacén de datos analíticos (data warehouse) para respaldar iniciativas de reportes, analítica, Machine Learning y Producto. Gestionar integralmente los pipelines asignados, desde su diseño y desarrollo hasta las pruebas, implementación y soporte en producción. Garantizar la calidad, integridad, seguridad y disponibilidad de los datos en todo el ecosistema. Colaboración multifuncional Colaborar con Gerentes de Producto, Científicos de Datos, Analistas y equipos de Ingeniería para comprender los requerimientos del negocio y traducirlos en soluciones técnicas. Contribuir a las discusiones sobre arquitectura de datos y a la estrategia de largo plazo de la plataforma. Trabajar con las distintas partes interesadas para identificar oportunidades de mejora de procesos y eficiencia operativa. Rendimiento y optimización Optimizar el almacenamiento, procesamiento y orquestación de datos para mejorar el rendimiento, la escalabilidad y la eficiencia de costos, incluyendo los costos de consultas y almacenamiento en BigQuery. Monitorear, diagnosticar y resolver problemas relacionados con los pipelines y la plataforma de datos, así como contribuir a las revisiones de incidentes. Implementar mejores prácticas de gobierno de datos, observabilidad, pruebas e integración y entrega continuas (CI/CD). Liderazgo y contribución al equipo Brindar mentoría y apoyo a ingenieros de datos junior mediante orientación técnica, revisiones de código e intercambio de conocimientos. Contribuir a las decisiones arquitectónicas y a la definición de mejores prácticas de ingeniería. Participar en entrevistas técnicas y apoyar el desarrollo de un equipo de Ingeniería de Datos de alto desempeño. REQUISITOS Y EXPERIENCIA Experiencia y habilidades requeridas Licenciatura o maestría en Ciencias de la Computación, Ingeniería, Sistemas de Información o un campo técnico relacionado. Más de 7 años de experiencia en Ingeniería de Datos, Data Warehousing o entornos de Big Data. Dominio avanzado de Python y SQL. Experiencia práctica en el desarrollo y gestión integral de pipelines de datos de nivel productivo, desde su diseño hasta su operación. Amplia experiencia con Google Cloud Platform (GCP), incluyendo BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub, Dataflow y Cloud Composer. También se considerará experiencia con AWS. Experiencia con herramientas de orquestación de flujos de trabajo y transformación de datos, como Airflow y dbt. Experiencia en el desarrollo de pipelines de datos en tiempo real o casi en tiempo real. Sólido conocimiento de las mejores prácticas de almacenamiento de datos (data warehousing), incluyendo modelado relacional y dimensional. Experiencia con herramientas de Infraestructura como Código (IaC), como Pulumi o Terraform. Sólido conocimiento de frameworks de procesamiento distribuido de datos, incluyendo Spark. Fuertes habilidades analíticas, de diagnóstico y resolución de problemas. Requisitos deseables Experiencia brindando soporte a flujos de trabajo de Machine Learning y Ciencia de Datos. Familiaridad con herramientas de observabilidad de datos, frameworks de calidad de datos y prácticas de integración y entrega continuas (CI/CD). Experiencia trabajando en organizaciones de suscripción, medios de comunicación, plataformas de streaming o productos digitales. REQUISITOS DE ELEGIBILIDAD Disponibilidad para trabajar en Santa Fe, Ciudad de México. Se verificará la experiencia laboral y académica. Univision es un empleador que ofrece equidad e igualdad de oportunidades. Todos los solicitantes calificados recibirán consideración para el empleo sin distinción de sexo, identidad de género, orientación sexual, raza, color, religión, origen nacional, discapacidad, estado de veterano protegido, edad o cualquier otra característica protegida por la ley.

Title: Sr Fraud Prevention Analyst
Industries: Retail Apparel and Fashion, Design Services, and Retail
Description: Job Location: Mexico City, Mexico Calling all originals: At Levi Strauss & Co., you can be yourself — and be part of something bigger. We’re a company of people who like to forge our own path and leave the world better than we found it. Who believe that what makes us different makes us stronger. So add your voice. Make an impact. Find your fit — and your future. The Sr Fraud Prevention Analyst supports LS&Co.'s Enterprise Fraud & Abuse Program by identifying, investigating, and helping mitigate fraud, abuse, and misuse across Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) channels. The primary focus of this role is ecommerce fraud detection, transaction monitoring, and fraud investigations supporting the U.S. and Canada business. The Sr Fraud Prevention Analyst will also provide investigative and analytical support for customer care and physical retail fraud and abuse matters, helping identify connections and trends across channels. This role combines fraud operations, investigative casework, transaction review, and data-driven analysis to protect revenue, inventory, customer experience, and brand trust. The analyst leverages fraud tools, operational data, investigative techniques, and emerging technologies to identify risks, detect fraud patterns, and support informed business decisions. The position supports the LS&Co.'s Enterprise Fraud & Abuse Center of Excellence (CoE). The role reports to the Director, Global Security and operates within a matrixed support model. While organizationally aligned to Global Security, the role maintains a primary functional reporting relationship to the Manager, Ecommerce Fraud & Risk, who provides day-to-day operational direction, coaching, prioritization, and performance oversight for ecommerce fraud operations. This includes responsibility for transaction review workflows, queue management, fraud policy execution, fraud analytics, abuse investigations, reporting, SLA adherence, and fraud prevention initiatives supporting the US and Canada ecommerce business. The role will partner closely with Global Security on broader cross-channel investigations, organized fraud activity, and enterprise fraud and abuse initiatives, while serving as a key operational bridge between ecommerce, consumer care, retail investigations, and revenue protection functions. About The Job Ecommerce Fraud Operations & Transaction Review (Primary Focus) Monitor omnichannel behavior and fraud model adjustments using fraud detection platforms, policy engines, and case management tools. Review high-risk orders, payments, customer accounts, refunds, and claims to determine appropriate action. Balance fraud risk mitigation with customer experience objectives by monitoring false positives, identifying opportunities to reduce customer friction, and helping ensure legitimate customer transactions are approved whenever appropriate. Investigate and resolve transactional anomalies, Customer Service escalations, and fraud, abuse, or loss prevention concerns escalated by store teams. Meet service level agreements (SLAs) related to escalation review and fraud operations. Identify emerging fraud tactics and analyze false positive metrics and customer friction points to recommend rule and model adjustments that maximize legitimate transaction approvals while maintaining risk thresholds. Fraud & Abuse Investigations Conduct investigations into fraud, abuse, and misuse affecting ecommerce, customer care, and physical retail channels. Investigate issues including payment fraud, Account Takeover (ATO), refund fraud, return abuse, loyalty fraud, promo and discount abuse, gift card fraud, claims fraud, employee discount misuse, and internal theft and collusion Document investigative findings and support case resolution activities. Escalate significant fraud events, trends, and organized fraud activity. Analytics & Intelligence Analyze transactional and operational data to identify fraud trends, anomalies, and root causes. Connect fraud signals across ecommerce, customer care, and store channels. Develop reports, dashboards, and case summaries to support decision-making. Assist with fraud loss measurement and performance reporting. Support the identification of organized fraud groups and repeat offenders. Program & Cross-Functional Support Partner closely with Ecommerce, Order Management, Customer Care, Global Security, Trust, Finance, Human Resources, Employee Relations, Legal, Digital, and IT teams. Support fraud mitigation initiatives and continuous improvement efforts. Recommend enhancements to fraud controls, workflows, and operating procedures. Contribute to enterprise fraud governance, reporting, and risk assessments. About You Required 3+ years of experience in fraud operations, fraud investigations, trust & safety, risk operations, retail asset protection, banking fraud, or related field. Experience conducting transaction reviews, fraud investigations, and risk-based decision making in an ecommerce or digital environment. Experience using fraud detection tools, transaction monitoring platforms, and case management tools. Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify patterns, trends, and anomalies across large datasets. Advanced Excel skills and experience working with large datasets. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Ability to exercise sound judgment and make risk-based decisions in a fast-paced environment. Experience balancing fraud prevention objectives and reducing friction for legitimate customers. Preferred Experience supporting ecommerce, retail, customer care, or global fraud programs. Experience with fraud prevention platforms such as Forter, Signifyd, Riskified, or similar solutions Experience with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, ServiceNow, Looker, and Arc. Working knowledge of SQL, Point-of Sale (POS) databases, and data visualization tools Experience working with Order Management Systems (OMS) and order lifecycle management processes Experience in a global retail environment. Experience or knowledge of conducting fraud, abuse, misconduct, or loss investigations LOCATION Mexico, D.F., Mexico FULL TIME/PART TIME Full time Current LS&Co Employees, apply via your Workday account.

Title: AI & Transformation Manager, Customer Success
Description: Descripción de la empresa En Doctoralia , nuestra misión es humanizar la experiencia de la salud a través de la tecnología. Como la plataforma líder en el mercado mexicano y referente global en soluciones SaaS para el sector médico, conectamos a millones de pacientes con especialistas, transformando la práctica clínica en una experiencia digital eficiente y centrada en el paciente. La misión El/la AI & Transformation Manager es dueño del modelo operativo de Customer Success en Doctoralia México: define cómo se atiende al doctor a lo largo de su ciclo de vida —activación, adopción, farming, upsell y churn— y decide, journey por journey, qué resuelve un agente automatizado, qué se queda en manos de una persona y por qué. Su razón de ser es cambiar la relación entre el tamaño de la cartera y el tamaño del equipo: que atender a más doctores deje de exigir proporcionalmente más gente, sin degradar la calidad de la relación con el doctor. Responde por el resultado en retención y en costo de servir , no por la cantidad de herramientas lanzadas. Su marco de actuación es la operación de CS México y los sistemas que la ejecutan. Colabora con Producto, Tech, Revenue Operations, el equipo de venta de productos adicionales, los Key Account Managers y los equipos globales del grupo. No es un rol de ciencia de datos: no entrena modelos, construye y opera los sistemas con los que trabaja el área. Lo que harás Modelo operativo: mapear el ciclo de vida del doctor y decidir, journey por journey, qué resuelve la IA en primera instancia y qué escala a una persona. Rediseño de journeys: reconstruir onboarding, farming, upsell y churn alrededor de agentes, con puntos de intervención humana definidos de forma explícita. Mejora continua: el modelo nunca está terminado — actualizarlo conforme cambian producto, herramientas y mercado, y retirar lo que deja de servir. Causas raíz de churn: atacar falla de pago, onboarding fallido y flujos de churn rotos rediseñando el journey, usando la señal que el negocio ya produce. Construcción real: prototipar con LLM APIs, frameworks de agentes y workflows, automatización low-code y SQL. Probar valor en alcance acotado antes de pedir inversión de plataforma. Kraken: evolucionar el outreach automatizado de recordatorios por reglas a agentes capaces de sostener una conversación y resolver la tarea sin escalar a una persona. Instrumentación: definir qué significa éxito en cada campaña automatizada y cerrar la brecha de conversaciones sin evaluación de resultado. Escalamiento: llevar los prototipos a sistemas soportados junto con Producto, Tech, Revenue Operations y equipos globales. Build vs. buy: evaluar proveedores cuando comprar gana a construir, y decirlo con claridad cuando no. Adopción real: responder por el uso diario de las herramientas por parte de CS, el equipo de upsell y los Key Account Managers — no por los lanzamientos. Governance de IA: definir qué puede decidir un modelo solo, qué debe escuchar un doctor de una persona, y bajo qué criterios se construye, compra o mata una iniciativa. Privacidad de datos: garantizar que ningún dato personal o clínico entre a prompts, logs o sistemas de terceros sin base legal y revisión documentada. Liderazgo: dirigir y hacer crecer a tu equipo; presentar resultados, hipótesis y apuestas fallidas a leadership local y de grupo en números claros. Lo que buscamos Mínimo 5 años de experiencia en operaciones comerciales, Customer Success, Service Operations o Revenue Operations, en un negocio de suscripción o marketplace. Al menos 2 años liderando equipo directo. Experiencia comprobable construyendo con IA —no solo usándola—: LLM APIs, frameworks de agentes o workflows, diseño de prompts y de evaluación, con sistemas en producción e impacto medible. Inglés Avanzado Capacidad de leer un P&L y defender una línea de presupuesto ante Finanzas. Experiencia gestionando proyectos multifuncionales con stakeholders más senior, sin autoridad formal sobre ellos. Deseable: experiencia en SaaS, marketplace o salud. ¿Te interesa construir el modelo operativo de CS de una de las plataformas de salud más grandes de Latinoamérica? Postúlate o comparte esta vacante con alguien que encaje. 🚀

Title: Agentic Success Manager
Description: Hi! We're Yalo We're on a mission to revolutionize how businesses sell with intelligent AI agents. Born in Latin America and driven by its spirit of innovation, we're now transforming how enterprises around the globe engage their customers and grow. We're entering our Agentic Era: we no longer just deploy conversational commerce — we put AI agents inside some of the world's largest enterprises, working alongside their commercial teams. Someone has to own whether those agents actually change the business. That is this role. The mission Turn strategic customer relationships into measurable business impact and sustainable growth — operating at the intersection of strategy, consulting, customer success, commercial growth and AI. This is not a traditional CSM role. No ticket queues. No adoption calls for the sake of adoption. You walk into an ambiguous business problem, structure it, use data to understand it, build the recommendation, prototype the AI solution, align senior stakeholders — and turn it into production and measurable results. What you'll accomplish in your first 18 months +45% net revenue growth across your existing portfolio 6+ high-value AI agent use cases in production, each backed by a quantified business case An executive sponsor in every strategic account who can articulate Yalo's ROI in their own business metrics Measurable impact across revenue, conversion, efficiency, retention or customer experience How you'll create that impact Diagnose — Understand the customer's business, economics, strategic priorities and customer journey. Structure — Turn complex, ambiguous problems into hypotheses, analysis and actionable recommendations. Build — Prototype, test and deploy AI agents and automations that solve real customer problems. Influence — Become a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders and mobilize cross-functional teams without direct authority. Commercialize — Identify whitespace, build business cases and partner with Sales to turn customer value into account growth. Scale — Turn successful use cases into repeatable opportunities across the customer's business. The non-negotiable: you build We sell AI agents. Title: Principal Data Engineer

El equipo de Ingeniería de Datos (Data Engineering) diseña, desarrolla y opera pipelines de datos de gran volumen y alta velocidad que impulsan ViX. Estos incluyen eventos de reproducción e interacción de usuarios, datos de suscripciones, información publicitaria y el almacén de datos analíticos (data warehouse), que permite transformar esta información en decisiones de negocio. El equipo colabora estrechamente con las áreas de Ingeniería, Producto, Ciencia de Datos y Analítica de TelevisaUnivision. El Principal Data Engineer desempeñará un papel clave como líder técnico en el diseño, desarrollo e implementación de nuestra plataforma de datos. Será fundamental para definir la arquitectura y la dirección técnica de la plataforma a varios años, participará directamente en la resolución de los desafíos más complejos relacionados con el procesamiento de datos en tiempo real y por lotes (batch), y brindará mentoría a ingenieros de niveles junior e intermedio para elevar los estándares de ingeniería de todo el equipo. El candidato ideal combina una sólida experiencia práctica en sistemas de datos distribuidos y procesamiento de datos en streaming con el criterio necesario para tomar decisiones arquitectónicas de largo plazo, la capacidad de influir y alinear equipos sin autoridad jerárquica directa y un compromiso genuino con el desarrollo profesional de otros ingenieros. SOBRE TI Eres un líder técnico con experiencia práctica que diseña plataformas completas, no solo pipelines de datos. Te sientes igualmente cómodo desarrollando código para entornos de producción, defendiendo decisiones arquitectónicas durante revisiones de diseño, colaborando con ingenieros junior para resolver problemas complejos y explicando las ventajas y desventajas de distintas soluciones a líderes ejecutivos. Cuentas Con Conocimiento experto de los servicios de datos de Google Cloud Platform (GCP), especialmente BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Dataflow (Apache Beam), Cloud Composer y Cloud Storage. Amplia experiencia en el diseño de arquitecturas en tiempo real y orientadas a eventos, incluyendo semánticas de procesamiento exactamente una vez (exactly-once), manejo de datos que llegan con retraso y evolución de esquemas. Dominio avanzado de Python y SQL, así como de frameworks de transformación de datos como dbt. Experiencia comprobada definiendo la dirección técnica de plataformas utilizadas por múltiples equipos y liderando su implementación a lo largo de varios trimestres. Experiencia con herramientas de Infraestructura como Código (IaC), como Pulumi o Terraform. Excelentes habilidades de resolución de problemas y capacidad para diseñar soluciones escalables y eficientes. Gran atención al detalle y capacidad para gestionar múltiples prioridades de manera efectiva. Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y colaboración, con capacidad para trabajar con equipos técnicos y no técnicos. Mentalidad de mejora continua y pasión por la mentoría y el intercambio de conocimientos. Interés genuino en desarrollar ingenieros junior y fomentar una cultura de ingeniería sólida. RESPONSABILIDADES DEL DÍA A DÍA Arquitectura de la plataforma de datos, desarrollo y estrategia técnica Desarrollar implementaciones de referencia, frameworks y bibliotecas reutilizables que puedan ser adoptadas por otros ingenieros, incluyendo plantillas de ingesta de datos, patrones de dbt y Airflow, y módulos de IaC en Pulumi. Liderar el diseño de pipelines de datos en tiempo real utilizando Pub/Sub y Dataflow, incluyendo esquemas de eventos, registros y evolución de esquemas, procesamiento exactly-once, gestión de marcas de tiempo (watermarking) y manejo de datos que llegan con retraso. Gestionar integralmente los pipelines asignados, desde su diseño y desarrollo hasta las pruebas, implementación y soporte en producción. Garantizar la calidad, integridad, seguridad y disponibilidad de los datos en todo el ecosistema. Colaboración multifuncional Colaborar con Gerentes de Producto, Científicos de Datos, Analistas y equipos de Ingeniería para comprender los requerimientos del negocio y traducirlos en soluciones técnicas. Contribuir a las discusiones sobre arquitectura de datos y a la estrategia de largo plazo de la plataforma. Trabajar con las distintas partes interesadas para identificar oportunidades de mejora de procesos y eficiencia operativa. Rendimiento y optimización Optimizar el almacenamiento, procesamiento y orquestación de datos para mejorar el rendimiento, la escalabilidad y la eficiencia de costos, incluyendo los costos de consultas y almacenamiento en BigQuery. Monitorear, diagnosticar y resolver problemas relacionados con los pipelines y la plataforma de datos, así como contribuir a las revisiones de incidentes. Implementar mejores prácticas de gobierno de datos, observabilidad, pruebas e integración y entrega continuas (CI/CD). Liderar la respuesta ante incidentes graves relacionados con los datos, realizar análisis posteriores a incidentes sin atribución de culpas (blameless postmortems) e impulsar soluciones estructurales para prevenir su recurrencia. Liderazgo y contribución al equipo Brindar mentoría y apoyo a ingenieros de datos junior mediante orientación técnica, revisiones de código e intercambio de conocimientos. Contribuir a las decisiones arquitectónicas y a la definición de mejores prácticas de ingeniería. Participar en entrevistas técnicas y apoyar el desarrollo de un equipo de Ingeniería de Datos de alto desempeño. Evaluar e impulsar la adopción de tecnologías emergentes, incluyendo flujos de trabajo de ingeniería asistidos por inteligencia artificial y herramientas de datos basadas en modelos de lenguaje de gran tamaño (LLM), manteniendo altos estándares de calidad y seguridad. REQUISITOS Y EXPERIENCIA Experiencia y habilidades requeridas Licenciatura o maestría en Ciencias de la Computación, Ingeniería, Sistemas de Información o un campo técnico relacionado, o experiencia equivalente. Más de 12 años de experiencia en Ingeniería de Datos, Data Warehousing o entornos de Big Data. Al menos 2 años de experiencia en un rol de liderazgo técnico (Tech Lead), definiendo la dirección técnica de múltiples equipos. Experiencia demostrable brindando mentoría y desarrollando ingenieros de niveles junior e intermedio. Trayectoria comprobada en el diseño y operación de plataformas de datos en tiempo real y de gran volumen en entornos de producción, por ejemplo, plataformas que procesan miles de millones de eventos al día. Experiencia de nivel experto con GCP: BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Dataflow (Apache Beam), Cloud Composer (Airflow) y Cloud Storage. También se considerará experiencia con AWS. Dominio experto de Python y SQL, así como experiencia con dbt en entornos de producción. Conocimiento profundo de conceptos de procesamiento de datos en streaming, incluyendo tiempo del evento frente al tiempo de procesamiento, ventanas de procesamiento (windowing), marcas de tiempo (watermarks), entrega exactly-once y mecanismos de control de presión (backpressure); experiencia con Kafka, Flink o Spark. Conocimiento experto en modelado de datos para analítica, incluyendo modelado dimensional, modelado de eventos y formatos de tablas lakehouse como Apache Iceberg. Amplia experiencia con Infraestructura como Código (Pulumi o Terraform), CI/CD y pruebas automatizadas para pipelines de datos. Experiencia demostrable gestionando la confiabilidad de los datos, incluyendo objetivos de nivel de servicio (SLO), observabilidad de datos, gestión de incidentes y análisis posteriores a incidentes. Experiencia comprobada en la reducción de costos de plataformas de datos en la nube a gran escala. Excelentes habilidades de comunicación escrita, verbal y de presentación, incluyendo la elaboración de documentos de diseño y la comunicación con audiencias técnicas y ejecutivas. Requisitos deseables Experiencia en empresas de suscripción, plataformas de video en streaming (OTT), medios de comunicación u organizaciones deportivas, incluyendo datos de calidad de reproducción, interacción de usuarios y publicidad en plataformas con anuncios (AVOD). Experiencia dando soporte a cargas de trabajo de Machine Learning y Ciencia de Datos, incluyendo pipelines de características (feature pipelines), características en tiempo real y datos para sistemas de recomendación y personalización. Experiencia con contratos de datos (data contracts), registros de esquemas (schema registries) y herramientas de catalogación o trazabilidad de datos (data lineage). REQUISITOS DE ELEGIBILIDAD Disponibilidad para trabajar en Ciudad de México. Se verificará la experiencia laboral y académica. Nuestra misión es ayudar a los clientes a reducir costos, aumentar la eficiencia y desbloquear nuevas oportunidades mediante soluciones de IA de vanguardia. Objetivo del Puesto Silia es la plataforma de CreAI para construir, conectar, gobernar y medir agentes de IA que operan dentro de la empresa. Buscamos un(a) Implementation Engineer Senior que sea dueño(a) end-to-end de las implementaciones más complejas de Silia en cuentas enterprise: las que involucran múltiples sistemas y múltiples áreas del cliente. Es un rol técnico y hands-on. Tu responsabilidad será mapear los procesos del cliente, diseñar los agentes, construir las integraciones y llevarlos a producción. Serás el referente técnico del equipo de implementación y el último punto de escalamiento para los problemas que nadie más resuelve. No esperamos que hagas todo esto a mano sino que tu manera de trabajar por default sea a través de orquestación y creación de agentes que te ayuden a cumplir tus objetivos de manera rápidas sin sacrificar calidad y seguridad. Responderás por el alcance, las fechas y la calidad comprometidos, sin que la velocidad que da la IA comprometa la estabilidad, la seguridad ni la confianza del cliente. También ayudarás a definir los estándares y prácticas de uso de IA que sigue el resto del equipo. Este Puesto Exige Ejecutar con autonomía implementaciones y ser dueño(a) de módulos y flujos completos, desde la configuración hasta la validación con el usuario final. Levantar requerimientos en sesiones de discovery y traducirlos en especificaciones de implementación, POCs y demos para el cliente. Configurar agentes de IA (RAG, domain topics, reglas de negocio) y construir integraciones API y en n8n hacia los sistemas del cliente. Trabajar con agentes de IA para construir, probar y documentar en lugar de hacerlo todo a mano, y validar y corregir su resultado antes de entregarlo. Convertir las tareas repetitivas en plantillas, flujos o agentes reutilizables. Ejecutar testing y debugging, documentar los resultados y mantener la documentación técnica al día. Reportar avances y riesgos a tiempo, y escalar los problemas con análisis y una propuesta de solución, no solo con el síntoma. Requisitos 6+ años como desarrollador(a) backend o fullstack, o en implementación o integración técnica de plataformas SaaS enterprise. Al menos 2 años liderando implementaciones o proyectos técnicos de cara al cliente, de principio a fin. Indispensable: Inglés mínimo B2 (Se hará evaluación en entrevistas) Experiencia definiendo la arquitectura de integraciones entre múltiples sistemas (APIs REST, webhooks, OAuth, JSON/XML). Python o JavaScript/TypeScript, y SQL. Experiencia integrando LLMs (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini u otros) en una aplicación o proceso real. Uso cotidiano de herramientas de IA agéntica (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot o similares). Inglés B2 o superior para sostener sesiones con stakeholders. Deseable: n8n u otra plataforma de automatización, experiencia con RAG, ecosistema Microsoft (SharePoint, Graph) o WhatsApp Business API, cloud (AWS, Azure) y requisitos de seguridad enterprise (ISO 27001, SOC 2). Beneficios 💻 Trabajo 100% remoto con horario alineado a CST. 🏖️ PTO ilimitado: Confiamos en que gestionarás tu tiempo de manera efectiva. 🎓 Presupuesto anual para desarrollo: Acceso a cursos, certificaciones y conferencias. 🛠️ Presupuesto para equipamiento: Configura tu espacio de trabajo remoto ideal. 🩺 Beneficio de salud: Acceso a cobertura médica privada o subsidios para seguro médico. 🚀 Oportunidades de crecimiento: Plan de carrera y mentoría con expertos en IA y tecnología. 🚀 Ambiente de startup dinámico y flexible: Autonomía para tomar decisiones y proponer ideas, con un enfoque en resultados en lugar de horas trabajadas. ⚖️ Balance vida-trabajo: Cultura que prioriza la flexibilidad y el bienestar, permitiéndote gestionar tu tiempo sin sacrificar tu vida personal. ¡ Te invitamos a postularte! Incluso si no cumples con todos los requisitos, valoramos experiencias y perspectivas diversas. Si te apasiona el reclutamiento y quieres crecer en una empresa enfocada en datos e IA, ¡nos encantaría conocerte!

Title: Process Improvement Mgr., Central Flow, Central Flow
Description: Description The Central Flow (CF) Sr. Process Specialist has Central Flow Experience and will own the strategy, mechanisms and initiatives within Central Flow LATAM that drive sustained CF Performance reflected in Speed and Delivery Estimate Accuracy (DEA) by proactively rightsizing labor to close capacity risk. Those initiatives include labor adjustment strategy and the levers that execute it, real-time capacity risk identification and response, rolled volume recovery mechanisms, and the development of standardized processes, automated reporting, and network-wide controls. Success hinges on balancing three critical metrics that pull against one another: Capped Out Hours (COH) & Capacity constrains, cost as measured by Throughput Per Hour (TPH), and Delivery Estimate Accuracy (DEA). This role partners with Field Operations, Finance, Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP), planning partner teams, Amazon Customer Excellence System (ACES), and Last Mile Tech (LMT), and is both a collaborator focused on implementing network-wide initiatives and the labor management partner for Regional Directors and Operations General Managers across two business lines. The Sr. CF Specialist works independently with multiple teams, they influence priorities through data-driven decision making and present complex solutions to Director-level leadership. To be successful in this role you need to pair analytical skills and a data-driven outlook with strong executive communication skills, demonstrate strong judgment in making time-sensitive decisions that impact delivery performance, labor utilization, and customer experience, be comfortable operating with limited guidance in an ambiguous, constantly changing environment, and be able to prepare and deliver detailed, data-driven business reviews with clear and effective narratives to senior leadership. Key job responsibilities Key job responsibilities The Process Improvement Manager will own capacity planning initiatives and Central FLow improvement tools. The Process Improvement Manager will support DEA and speed by proactively rightsizing labor to close capacity risk before it becomes a delivery miss, and will drive proactive labor management for rolled volume recovery — building the playbooks, escalation paths, and decision guardrails. The Process Improvement Manager will design the governance model for shift labor levers, defining decision rights between Central Flow and the field so that same-day actions are fast, consistent, and auditable across two business lines with different tooling and maturity. The Process Improvement Manager will implement automated reporting, real-time visibility, and model-driven mechanisms that surface FC shift risk before it becomes a delivery miss, and will document Standard Operating Procedures so execution does not depend on a single owner. The Process Improvement Manager will develop trust-based relationships with Regional Directors, General Managers, Operations Managers, and functional partners across S&OP, AMZL and MM. About The Team Central Flow LATAM team is looking on worldwide amazonians that want to come and make history within this newly born region having a top high visibility with Sr. Leadership and able to create and deliver strategies that set the base to a raise the bar results.
